thread.title: Roku Stock Spikes To All-Time High On New Set-Top Boxes | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Roku Stock Spikes To All-Time High On New Set-Top Boxes | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Roku stock surged to a record high Wednesday, two days after the streaming video platform announced new set-top boxes in time for the holiday shopping season.
X Roku ( ROKU ) stock added 0.4% to close at 73.34 on the stock market today . In intraday trading, it notched an all-time high of 75.30.
The Los Gatos, Calif.-based company went public at $14 a share in September 2017. Roku stock is on IBD's Leaderboard stock list .
On Monday, Roku expanded its streaming-player lineup with two new devices. The Roku Premiere costs $39.99 and offers a simple way for consumers to stream video in high definition, 4K Ultra HD or 4K HDR (high dynamic range) quality. The Roku Premiere Plus costs $49.99 and adds a voice remote control. The devices will be available in early October.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Low-Cost Devices To Stream 4K Video "At under $40, the new Roku Premiere is our lowest-priced 4K streaming player ever, and it's going to give consumers the best picture quality their TV can handle," Lloyd Klarke, Roku director of product management, said in a news release . "Tens of millions of 4K TVs will be sold this year. We're seeing more content, even live sports, produced and streamed in 4K and HDR as each week goes by."
Roku also updated its top-of-the-line streaming player, the Roku Ultra, to include premium JBL headphones but kept the same price of $99.99.
In the streaming device market, Roku competes with Amazon.com 's ( AMZN ) Fire TV and Apple 's ( AAPL ) Apple TV, among others. These gadgets are designed to stream internet video from Netflix ( NFLX ), Hulu, HBO and a host of other services.
Last week, Amazon unveiled its first set-top streaming box with a digital video recorder. The Fire TV Recast starts at $229.99. It lets you watch, record and replay free over-the-air broadcast TV programming and stream it to anywhere via your mobile device.
